U_0x014A35: A humanoid mobile weapon for ground and artillery combat, also called the Type 30. Slow but thickly armored, it is a stable, reliable machine that can also hover, giving it excellent rough-terrain mobility. The Randgrith Raven is a modified Randgrith with a booster pod carrying a <Tesla Drive>, and its two linear cannons give it improved firepower.
U_0x014C8A:
A machine built by the Holy Kingdom of Langran in the subterranean world of <La Gias>. Blessed by the wind spirit Cyfis, it is known as the "<Masoukishin> of the Wind." Its Fulcanelli perpetual engine requires the operator's (pilot's) <Prana> for peak efficiency; <Prana> is essentially "ki" or "aura," so output depends greatly on the operator's aptitude.
The airtight frame allows action underwater and in space, and a self-circulation system protects the operator's body on long sorties. Aether - massless energy at rest in absolute coordinates - serves as its magical propulsion medium. The Orichalconium armor, sealed at particle level with numerological ward patterns, grants high magical defense.
Its Laplace Demon-type computer calculates causality to predict events, though this hinges on the operator's own magic. "Cybuster" is a guardian name against magical attack, not its true name.
U_0x01526F: zCybuster's cruising form, modeled on Dishnas, divine bird of Langran.
U_0x015327: Second machine of the Valsion series, developed by <DC> leader Bian Zoldark for his daughter Lune. Artificial muscles transmit power through the frame, giving it flexible, human-like movement (even facial expressions) far beyond any <Personal Trooper> or <Armored Module>. A compact, improved <Tesla Drive> allows independent flight. Armed with the wide-area Psycho Blaster plus the Cross Smasher and Divine Arm from the Valsion, its combat power is very high. The DML (Direct Motion Link) control system lets pilot and machine move as one.
U_0x0156CD: VThe Valsione, second Valsion-series unit, enhanced with <La Gias> alchemy. The ABMD system drives its frame and the DML system traces the pilot's motions, giving it flexible, human-like movement no other humanoid weapon can match.
U_0x0158A0: SShu's anti-alien combat <Armored Module>. It runs on an antimatter engine, with armor of ultra-tensile titanium reinforced at the particle level. Built for firepower and defense over mobility, its attack power is immense; co-designer Eric Wong said that with a pilot of superhuman ability it could crush the world's forces in a day. Shu's Kabbalah program reportedly lets it use astral energy. It hides many black boxes, but since Shu went independent after the <DC War> began, its sealed secrets remain a mystery.
